name: pagination-dots
title: Pagination Dots
description: Page indicator for carousels and onboarding that follows your finger: hand it a live scroll position and the active dot stretches into a pill that pours into the next one, dots scale, segments fill, or the page number rolls. Tap a dot to jump; VoiceOver can swipe through pages.
props: Active page; changes spring the indicator across.
Live page position (e.g. Animated.divide(scrollX, width)) for smooth tracking while swiping. Use useNativeDriver: false for the 'dots' variant.
Stretching pill · growing dot · filling segments · rolling "2 / 5".
Makes dots tappable (44pt hit area) and enables accessibility increment / decrement.
Style for the row of dots (the numbers pill or line track in those variants).
